samples.question: Four square panels are stacked vertically and read top to bottom as panel 1, panel 2, panel 3, panel 4. Every panel shows the same static 3x3 grid of cells. One token (a filled red disk) sits in a single cell of each panel. The magenta ring marks the token's starting cell in the top panel. Between each consecutive pair of panels a navy dot declares the token's one-cell move (up, down, left, or right) to the next panel. Following the moves in order from the ringed start cell, how many distinct cells does the token occupy across all four panels? Count the start cell in panel 1 and every cell it lands on. Answer '1', '2', '3', or '4'.
